Budesonide has been used in a few small controlled studies1-5 of the management of collagenous colitis (see Microscopic Colitis, p.1700). Treatment courses given oral- ly for 6 or 8 weeks were found to improve symptoms and histol- ogy, and the short-term benefits have been confirmed by meta- analysis,6 although high rates of relapse after stopping treatment have been reported.3,5 1.
